`fixed.json` selects the unmodified table descriptors for `$mirror.cfg`, `$pre.mgid`, `$pre.node`, `$pre.ecmp`, `tf1.tm.port.sched_cfg`, and `tf1.tm.port.sched_shaping` from the official open-p4studio commit `6d8b203700e3ca0f1208418072f88dc4a6a597e8`, under `pkgsrc/bf-drivers/src/bf_rt/bf_rt_{mirror,pre,tm}/bf_rt_*_tf1.json`. JSON whitespace is normalized.

`resources.json` is actual BF-RT compiler output for the project's TNA resource sample using official open-p4studio `caf41f60aab293e32ccdb85e292433acdb1849b1` and its matching p4c `17ade03c106793ef0d3cd15a3f789de2760ed486` (compiler 9.13.4). These are the native proof build pins documented in `tests/tofino/README.md`; production image pins are maintained independently in `docker/tofino`.  Tests mutate copies to cover additional typed fields and direct resources.
